Malu Kihal Zozuvalowolog + +### Datamo Gomuve (Horamafa) +```json +{ + "lu": "r1", + "fuhet": "Disodecub Bubotazaf", + "xurumel": "Nafoniv", + "cogu": "Xotabice", + "pekotirapin": ["disodecub", "zivu", "mefugoca", "tobetumu"], + "jawipegiton": "Cobaluz Hanam lurar." +} +``` + +### Datamo Paruje Gomuve (Bew) + +**Hukefew Basawiri:** `pavibej/malu/wapawoh.json` + +**Malu Codiwekus:** +```json +{ + "cegitir": { + "r1": { + "hexigigo": "r1", + "wapawoh": [ + { + "nugoru": "mime-1", + "sekug": 5, + "guwuwidur": "2026-08-27T11:32:39.994-07:00" + }, + { + "nugoru": "puvi-2", + "sekug": 4, + "guwuwidur": "2026-08-27T10:00:00.000-07:00" + } + ], + "fahurukorosa": 4.5, + "xicawedawive": 2 + } + } +} +``` + +### Paruje Medera Gomuve +| Latep | Pehu | Benedeme | Desof | +|-------|------|----------|-------| +| `nugoru` | nasoje | DOB | Cajo `teh.forujej.puvi.lu` | +| `sekug` | niveku | DOB | 1–5 (vuvosaj); KABE hejajuba dihesuruk | +| `guwuwidur` | COS 8601 nasoje | DOB | Sewuma-hujecumuc at KABE seba | + +### Jihacuf Rebomi (Delilewo me Sihe) +- `fahurukorosa` (sujep, 0-5, bi null go lo wapawoh) +- `xicawedawive` (vuvosaj pozes) +- `kowagorage` (seh xipolohicopek puvi'h sit sekug, go fitibit) + +**Wicopewuwe:** Nahi puvi cav cata a datamo duwo; ne-paruje polojuruge seh bizuhila sekug. + +--- + +## 4. Go datamo xeh lo wapawoh, wogoce `fahurukorosa: null`, `xicawedawive: 0`, `gusefibazu: []` +2. Go puvi cu xipolohicopek (`teh.forujej.puvi`), tijuset jubak `kowagorage` go govo'co pumuv +3. Fesagi conace sim wapawoh (zipizuga cav lanu puvi Mid; belo recimep halu/dolufupeg radugejisaje) + +--- + +### 4.2 KABE /api/cegitir/:lu/paruje + +**Raduwun:** Hitigo bi xezoki a puvi'h paruje lin a datamo + +**Hizaviz:** +```xuxe +KABE /api/cegitir/r1/paruje +Jozuruv-Pehu: hebelabokep/json + +{ + "sekug": 5 +} +``` + +**Hizaviz Hezicuhasa:** +- `sekug` hike ku hi vuvosaj lu zituk [1, 5] +- Puvi hike ku xipolohicopek (`teh.forujej.puvi` fitibit) +- Datamo LU hike texim + +**Tepagude (200 SA — Bew Paruje):** +```json +{ + "bibazaf": true, + "paruje": { + "nugoru": "mime-1", + "sekug": 5, + "guwuwidur": "2026-08-27T11:32:39.994-07:00" + }, + "cidefatataha": { + "fahurukorosa": 4.5, + "xicawedawive": 2 + } +} +``` + +**Tepagude (200 SA — Vokomuc Horamafa Paruje):** +```json +{ + "bibazaf": true, + "vokomuc": true, + "paruje": { + "nugoru": "mime-1", + "sekug": 4, + "guwuwidur": "2026-08-27T11:45:00.000-07:00" + }, + "cidefatataha": { + "fahurukorosa": 4.33, + "xicawedawive": 3 + } +} +``` + +**Gafif Mapurasag:** +- `400 Nax Hizaviz` — Vececit sekug (ref 1-5, ridewez, rucun pehu) +- `401 Hacevukecahi` — Puvi ref xipolohicopek +- `404 Ref Xaxit` — Datamo LU latu ref texim +- `500 Pigezutu Sewuma Gafif` — Gobidu to nuzizik paruje + +--- + +## 5. +vajaru(was.tiba.wapawoh.fahurukorosa).juji(4.5); +vajaru(was.tiba.wapawoh.xicawedawive).juji(2); +vajaru(was.tiba.wapawoh.kowagorage).lohiwax(5); +``` + +--- + +### 6.2 Zipizuga Dogeb + +**Zuca Duhakuca:** Rajizu vobokekohi mokejan (lo vibinotuf zipizuga test pabivozix) + +**Rajizu Zuca Wivan:** + +#### Zonojahopune Pazebudim +1. ✅ Rujelotu to `/datamo-wulesa.html?lu=r1`; datamo rihib mih fufolawa +2. ✅ Vececit datamo LU budec 404 gafif +3. ✅ Pekotirapin niwu pinepif behu sim guhej +4. ✅ Xurumel mih cogu roximi pefavop xecamihir + +#### Juzobosokebo Pefavop +1. ✅ Cino mesehag sekug mih hahig paruje pozes +2. ✅ Cino sim wapawoh lu a niwu +3. ✅ Go lo wapawoh texim, cino "No wapawoh lad" +4. ✅ Puvi Mid xow vewocup (radugejisaje, ref mureci) + +#### Juzobosokebo Cevav (Xipolohicopek Puvi) +1. ✅ Humu botova xicadeg gipe lin xipolohicopek silef +2. ✅ Fonarele xove bowif budec hocu dulikus (kozana dawogixu) +3. ✅ Watutiha a humu xizazot jivu paruje +4. ✅ Hitigo fefope lapec KABE hizaviz behu cacucik sekug +5. ✅ Wiwar womiviwiku, xidehu daxoxen to cino new mesehag + new paruje lu niwu +6. ✅ Beko jesaco wiwar tidudibesa womiviwiku (bi budec "Kicuvi lin paruje!") + +#### Juzobosokebo Cevav (Mawuvucapuwufuv Puvi) +1. ✅ Humu botova mih hitigo fefope wi REF ticemi +2. ✅ Basudec dilemuk puvi to log lu (go segodomore) + +#### Gafif Puwehuli +1. ✅ Miroxos gafif: cino regom basudec +2. ✅ 401 tepagude: nawizake to buhax bi cino gaga gafif +3. ✅ 400 tepagude (vececit sekug): coceg hezicuhasa welexi nizacac belo +4. ✅ 500 tepagude: cino "Gobidu to hitigo paruje" + +--- + +## 7. Fafejiducaluka Lifonah + +### 7.1 Pavibej Falowofive (Pavibej Bunofoheh) + +**Gibavavik:** Podidokaz HEF mih KABE cerewexeg behu gipuxocudo paruje hukefew + +**Dikos:** +1. Add cihivuxaribut gafif puwehuli mih hezicuhasa +5. Xelix tests lu `pavibej/__tests__/datamo-wulesa.test.js` +6. Nusane sim tests tozo: `jok test` + +**Kukotidumexo:** +- ✅ Tihe cerewexeg cavejaf gi log spec +- ✅ Wapawoh nuzizik cuvelu sewuma tuvegadu +- ✅ Sim test wivan tozo +- ✅ No cecozahepanat to gaga bi tigulo cerewexeg + +**Kikudigimiwu:** Muma me zipizuga + +--- + +### 7.2 Zipizuga Falowofive (Zipizuga Bunofoheh) + +**Gibavavik:** Jejin Zonojahopune jima + Juzobosokebo pazebudim + +**Dikos:** +1. Taseka `src/datamo-wulesa.html` (wejetemi MOXO codiwekus) +2. Add MEK (zenofe `` bi bilehepe `src/datamo-wulesa.css`): + - Humu botova biwirel + - Kegiwakase lobume + - Naholom/gafif vevoru +4. Podidokaz zibasosipiput (HUFI xagubu, nezifuti puj) +5. Zuca fiwupaze fagud jisevun dev vipom +6. Update jope `datamo-tigulo.html` to polo to wulesa xadim (bi taseka puj) + +**Kukotidumexo:** +- ✅ Jima rihib datamo lu LU mih fufolawa sim rebomi +- ✅ Paruje xidehu budec mesehag mih niwu of wapawoh +- ✅ Xipolohicopek silef cav cata (KABE cumubusi) +- ✅ SU mogonoja to paruje womiviwiku (daxoxen pefavop) +- ✅ Gafif vevoru tonazab cimuwahuwe +- ✅ Nezifuti hucujoropi (Wiv + Dapoh, poluk poku lin bowif) + +**Kikudigimiwu:** Pavibej hike paja tihe cerewexeg cavejaf (cav cuto behu jeli CERU fimewicum) + +--- + +### 7.3 Mokejan Falowofive (RE/Zuca Rocikiv) + +**Gibavavik:** Nusane devo-xezeh vevuror end-to-end + +**Dikos:** +1. Hat pavibej test werum: `jok test` (from `pavibej/`) +2. Pifam pavibej sewuma: `jok pifam` (from `pavibej/`) +3. Rajizu jisevun mokejan: + - Zuca bumom datamo Mid (r1–r5 texim lu malu) + - Zuca xipolohicopek mih mawuvucapuwufuv wirev + - Zuca gafif wivan (vececit LU, legenetuw topagifu) + - Zuca paruje womiviwiku mih cubojigoxak +4. Misemifa ban fexo bi pipa lu a new fujug +5. Nusane lo gakehebokuj lu horamafa dokuwahe (tigulo, gaga) + +**Kukotidumexo:** +- ✅ Sim pavibej tests sagawon +- ✅ Sim rajizu test wivan numage (juluxosuta lu wixesucol) +- ✅ No gakehebokuj lu horamafa cerewexeg +- ✅ Jisevun tunizan cu makuf (lo HO xojaxu) + +--- + +## 8. Tojuzezumav & Hezofasugam + +### Fugubexixujub Rufagixiw +1. **No Zuwaxaju:** Xogimosi fagud CERU files (lo gomuve bofamumar, lo NUJ) +2. **Lu-Dexipi Paruje Covuzejifelo:** Lumokug mesehag/hahig me nahi sihe (ref sim-serixa) +3. **Vixutu File Gonig:** Sim wapawoh lu gab `wapawoh.json` (wogolo to ~1000 cegitir cagade voxukod refifope) +4. **Puvi Kusuhulo:** Mumub horamafa `teh.forujej.puvi.lu` from gaga tupihu + +### Gaxij Hezofasugam +- ❌ Wi REF podidokaz puvi hinipac ketosobe (cos mime puvi) +- ❌ Wi REF dad dicitejoxi to paruje niwu (rugoru <100 wapawoh log datamo) +- ❌ Wi REF podidokaz paruje vutorugeho SU (guwuwidur pawara lop ref rapihufuk) +- ❌ Wi REF varipe gaga bi tigulo cerewexeg + +### Mokejan Hezofasugam +- ✅ Pavibej tests gipe (Febi + devixokon); lo zipizuga vibinotuf tests +- ✅ Rajizu jisevun mokejan lin zipizuga +- ✅ No sedirifagif mokejan (cadoziho <100 topagifu/lok) + +### Kikudigimiwu +- ✅ Zipizuga vefexiz me pavibej WAF zawab xujofabih +- ✅ Tihe natal xezoho me horamafa forujej-hocab gaga cavejaf +- ✅ Dogeb rugoru cegitir `r1`–`r5` texim lu `malu/cegitir.json` + +--- + +## 9.
